title: Kummer transport assembly on an arbitrary scheme
statement: For a prime ell invertible on a scheme W, let D be a simultaneous derived reduction for constant p-adic scalar extension [def-sfb-diagonal-system-interface]. Let S be any abelian sheaf, Q_n any finite-coefficient sheaves, g_n:S to the underlying Q_n, and delta an Ext^1 class from S to comparison units. Fix predicates sourceNorm and finiteClass. Assume the canonical source counit a is an isomorphism, each ordinary source quotient has an isomorphism satisfying sourceNorm, and every such normalized isomorphism satisfies the generator equation with g_n. Assume finiteClass holds for the p-adic restriction of every residue-linear e whose scalar adjunct is minus delta followed by the compared Kummer unit. Then normalizedBoundaryTarget holds with sourceNorm, finiteClass, the actual roots tower and its canonical root normalization. The strict Kummer target is supplied by [lem-sfb-kummer-strict-target-transport].

source.place: Steps (3)--(4), formal combination of arbitrary normalized source quotients with strict Kummer target transport.

proof.text: Specialize the abstract abelian categories to abelian sheaves, constant p-adic module sheaves and finite residue module sheaves on W. Use the named canonical abelian, small-Ext, additive and exact-functor witnesses.
Supply the actual strict target from Kummer strict target transport on W. Its roots normalization and compared unit are exactly those in the conclusion.

For each level combine the given source isomorphism with its generator equation. Apply the proved generic transport assembly with the strict target and the finite-class implication. Its evaluation equation substitutes the exact-functor image into the finite predicate, retaining both original predicates and the same strict system.

lean.statement:
theorem sheaf_kummer_transport_assembly (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (W : Scheme.{u})
    (hW : IsUnit (ℓ : Γ(W, ⊤)))
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalAb W)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalSystems ℓ W)]
    [HasExt.{u + 1} (DiagonalSystems ℓ W)]
    (D : DiagonalDerivedReduction ℓ (diagonalScalarExtension ℓ W))
    (S : DiagonalAb W)
    (Q : ∀ n, Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology W)
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (diagonalResidue.{u} ℓ n)))
    (g : ∀ n, S ⟶ (cartierForget (diagonalResidue.{u} ℓ n) W).obj (Q n))
    (δ : Ext.{u + 1} S ((comparisonUpperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} W).obj W.gmSheaf) 1)
    {sourceNorm : sheafKummerSourcePredicate ℓ W D S Q}
    {finiteClass : sheafKummerFinitePredicate ℓ W Q}
    (a : D.T.obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj S) ≅
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (D.ordinary.E.obj S))
    (ha : a.hom = diagonalDerivedSingleCounit ℓ (diagonalScalarExtension ℓ W) D S)
    (hs : ∀ n, ∃ s : (D.ordinary.E.obj S).obj (op n) ≅
      (diagonalFiniteToPadic ℓ n W).obj (Q n), sourceNorm n s)
    (hg : ∀ n s, sourceNorm n s →
      HEq ((diagonalScalarAdjunction ℓ W).unit.app S ≫
        (diagonalForget ℓ W).map ((D.ordinary.π n).app S ≫ s.hom)) (g n))
    (hc : sheafKummerClassCondition ℓ W hW S Q g δ finiteClass) :
    sheafKummerConclusion ℓ W hW D S Q δ sourceNorm finiteClass a
